research_notes: Initial research 2026-10-01: official occupation list, employer annual reviews, employer statement and first-person interview reviewed. Searches for pharmacy outlet, individual hours, public professional profile and school governance did not resolve payroll/full-time status. Generic biography assertions of part-time work lack reliable corroboration and were not adopted.

Follow-up: TerryWhite outlet/legal entity, hours and leave; exact school-program employment versus participation/volunteering and overlapping work; UWU start conflict; pre-2018 work/study history; Australian Islamic College 2022 board lead, appointment/end/remuneration. Official exact dates alone are insufficient for full-time years.

Recovered source errors: American Rhetoric first-speech mirror403; ERCWA2021–22 PDF400 Timeout fetching, indexed primary passage used; school-board reference click could not resolve. These are individual source gaps, not job-wide blockers.
Family members’ occupations are not Payman’s employment. Pharmacy assistant wording is not upgraded to pharmacist. No duration is summed across overlapping intervals.
